modifications: Converted Wavefront OBJ to Draco-compressed GLB; preserved original topology and independent FJ mesh IDs; transformed source millimetres (x,y,z) to metres (x,z,-y)/1000; 18-bit per-mesh Draco position quantization. System buckets derived from source hierarchy and names.

coordinates.sourceToApp: BodyParts3D original body frame followed by side-specific orbital registration translations; see source-provenance.json.

limitations: Original source is adult male anatomy, not a complete representation of all possible anatomy.
Some source structures are absent, including many peripheral nerves. No anatomy was fabricated to fill gaps.
Original OBJ comments retain historic CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan text. The currently applicable archive license page, updated 2025-02-27, states CC BY 4.0; its HTML is preserved beside the archive.
System assignment is for navigation; original FMA mappings and all geometry are retained.

subset.modifications: Original Draco attributes and materials preserved; glTF nodes translated into the paired Z-Anatomy eye frame. No geometry was re-encoded or welded.
subset.scope: Twelve named paired orbital branch/ganglion surfaces; existing Z-Anatomy ophthalmic trunks are retained separately.
